title: Find a household battery recycling location
summary: Find out where and how to recycle various types of household batteries safely in NSW.
intro:
You can recycle many types of household batteries at B-cycle drop-off locations around NSW. Batteries should not be placed into household waste or recycling bins as the chemicals and components could damage the environment or cause fires.

If you have more than 1kg of batteries, call the drop-off location to see if they accept the types and quantity at that location.

who_can_apply: Residents of NSW with household batteries to recycle
what_you_need: If you have more than 1kg of batteries, call the drop-off location to confirm acceptance of types and quantity.

faqs.q: Where can I recycle household batteries?
faqs.a: You can recycle many types of household batteries at B-cycle drop-off locations around NSW.

faqs.q: What types of batteries can I recycle?
faqs.a: Accepted batteries include lithium-ion and lead-acid batteries.

faqs.q: What batteries should I not put in household waste?
faqs.a: Batteries should not be placed into household waste or recycling bins because their chemicals and components could damage the environment or cause fires.
